bias.en: Rebound stalling · lost $201.5, at the 5- and 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹受阻 · 跌破 $201.5，位于 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Zscaler fell 5.3% on Nov 20 to $194.82, trading $193.13–206.00 on heavy volume (1.49x the 20-day average). It sits on the 5-day ($194.9, rising) and 10-day ($194.8, falling), below the falling 30-day ($218.0) and above the rising 100-day ($187.7) and 200-day ($166.7). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 19 ($181.22), and RSI is 42.2.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月20日下跌 5.3%，收于 $194.82，盘中区间 $193.13–206.00，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.49 倍）。股价落在 5 日（$194.9，上行）和 10 日均线（$194.8，下行）上，位于下行的 30 日均线（$218.0）下方，在上行的 100 日（$187.7）和 200 日均线（$166.7）上方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月19日起看多（$181.22），RSI 为 42.2。

read.en: The pullback gave back the $201.5–203.3 reclaim (Nov 19 and Oct 16 lows) and closed under $196 (Nov 13 high, Nov 18 close), both now resistance. Resistance is $195.1–197.8, then $201.5–206 and $210.5. Support is $193.1–194.8 (10-day, Nov 20 low), then $186.5–187.7 (100-day, Nov 16 low) and $181.2–185.2 (SAR, Nov 17 close). A close above $197.8 would target $201.5–206; below $193.1, $186.5–187.7.
